criteria.text: The response produces a reusable skill (a [company]-ppt-template directory with SKILL.md and assets/template.pptx) instead of directly building a presentation for the user's content.
criteria.source: Intro: 'This skill creates SKILLS, not presentations'; Step 5 directory structure

criteria.text: The response analyzes the provided template with python-pptx (or equivalent) and reports actual values: slide dimensions in inches, layout count and names, and placeholder idx/type values per layout. Bracketed placeholders are not left unfilled.
criteria.source: Step 2: Analyze Template; Generated SKILL.md Template

criteria.text: The generated SKILL.md documents exact placeholder positions (x/y coordinates in inches) for key layouts, including title, subtitle, and footer/source placeholders.
criteria.source: Step 2 'Key measurements'; Placeholder Mapping 'CRITICAL: Include exact positions'

criteria.text: The content area top boundary comes from the OBJECT placeholder's y position (type 7) when one exists, not from the end of the subtitle. Any reserved gap such as a border or line is identified as off-limits.
criteria.source: Step 2: Finding the True Content Start Position

criteria.text: The generated SKILL.md defines safe content area boundaries (left margin, top, width, height) for custom shapes, tables, and charts so they do not overlap template placeholders.
The generated SKILL.md includes code that deletes all existing slides from the template before adding new slides.
The generated skill's content-filling instructions use paragraph.level for bullet hierarchy and explicitly say not to add manual bullet characters.

The generated SKILL.md is self-contained. It has YAML frontmatter (name, description with branded usage triggers), a key layouts table, and cover and content slide examples, and it requires no reference to ppt-template-creator.
The response generates a sample presentation from the new skill to validate it works, and packages the skill (for example, as a .skill file via skill-creator) or describes doing so.
criteria.source: Workflow steps 6-7; Step 6: Create Example Output
